action_items.note: Criterion 'dashboard retains simulation results and shows a clear AI-only error if Claude cannot complete a review' could not be actively triggered end-to-end: Claude completed successfully on every real run, and there is no supported way to force a provider failure without mocking application code (out of scope for this agent). The error-path UI (aiError banner, results retained) was code-reviewed in frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx (aiMutation.onError / stream 'error' event handling) and looks correct, but is unverified by a live failure. Recommend a light backend fault-injection hook if this path needs hard proof.

checks.criterion: The existing Thermal Atlas analysis flow remains functional
checks.name: thermal-flow-produces-results
checks.evidence: Run thermal analysis revealed metric cards, temperature chart, heat-flow card, scenario comparison table, and recommendation title with no regression from the empty state.

checks.criterion: Claude design review is available after an analysis
checks.name: ai-review-card-ready-after-analysis
checks.evidence: After results appeared, ai-review-card showed 'Claude Sonnet 4.6' badge, the optional question textarea, all three focus buttons, and an enabled generate-ai-review-button.

checks.criterion: All three Claude modes can be selected
checks.name: ai-focus-modes-toggle-active
checks.evidence: Clicking explain, report, and back to review each toggled focus-button-active onto exactly the clicked control and off the previous one.

checks.criterion: Claude responses stream into the UI and complete; Claude receives the exact analysis context
checks.name: ai-review-streams-and-completes
checks.evidence: Selected 'Explain results', asked a question, clicked Generate: streamed partial text appeared before completion, ai-review-complete ('stream saved · <id>') appeared within ~20s, final response cited the model's exact wall-loss value (3.4 kWh / 29% of 11.6 kWh total, matching the 'Insulated composite envelope' run), no ai-review-error panel, and zero browser console errors.

checks.criterion: Claude API validation and graceful failure contract are safe (validation half)
checks.name: test_tscheck_ai_review_validation.py
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/ai/review returned 422 for a missing analysis field, an invalid focus literal, and a question exceeding the 1200-char max_length.

checks.criterion: Completed Claude reviews persist; Claude receives the exact analysis context
checks.name: test_tscheck_ai_review_history.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/analyze -> POST /api/ai/review (SSE) streamed delta events with non-empty content and a done event with a review_id; GET /api/ai/history then returned that id with non-empty response, focus='review', recommendation matching the analysis, a created_at timestamp, and model='claude-sonnet-4-6'.
